method: Original issue bodies and paginated public conversation comments through GitHub REST API. External linked reductions/proofs were not fetched or executed; collection and hashes are not equivalence proofs.

reports.title: [CVP] Missed vector select simplification for `select (icmp ult X, 1<<N), (and X, (1<<N)-1), K`
reports.scope: Packed unsigned < power-of-two / <= contiguous-low-mask compare supplies a bound to the true arm of a compatible same-or-finer-granularity blend or canonical bitwise selection. Remove only the matching AND mask. Eight integer lane/register shapes; signed/noncontiguous/mixed/coarser shapes refuse.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Generalise `bitreverse(bitreverse(x) << 1) => x >> 1` to more complex operations on `x`
reports.scope: Private same-width BitReverse networks over AND/OR/XOR/NOT and fixed valid logical shifts are conjugated by bit permutation; all six original shapes are covered at IR level. Shared internal operations, casts, arithmetic, AShr and invalid counts refuse; shared reversal leaves are retained when needed.

reports.title: [InstCombine] Fold `select (x == -1), y, umin(x, y)` to `umin(x, y)`
reports.scope: All-ones unsigned sentinel select around an already existing scalar min select reuses that min. Same bound SSA operand, width, Eq/Ne arm orientation and unsigned min provenance are mandatory. No general min/max intrinsic or arbitrary sentinel is claimed.

reports.title: [SE] Prove umin/umax comparisons before operand canonicalization
reports.scope: Direct signed/unsigned <= and strict-opposite observations of existing scalar min/max selects against either operand fold before offset arithmetic obscures their structure. This does not implement the upstream memory-safety/ScalarEvolution/vectorizer constraint solver.
